Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Your Role

- Provide detailed financial analysis to business leaders on actuals, forecasts, budgets, and variances, enabling informed decision-making.

- Own end-to-end FP&A; processes including rolling forecasts, annual budgeting, and long-term financial planning.

- Manage P&L; / portfolio financials, ensuring revenue optimization, cost control, and margin improvement.

- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (finance, sales, delivery, PMO) to support business operations and growth.

- Provide data-driven insights for strategic decisions, including investments, cost optimization, and business expansion.

- Drive process improvements, automation, and analytics adoption in financial processes.

- Contribute to Thought Leadership by developing insights, financial narratives, and best practices across Financial Services.

- Bring in domain expertise in Wealth Management / BFSI to enhance financial analysis and business context.

Your Profile

- 2–18 years of experience in FP&A;, Financial Controlling, or related finance roles (based on seniority and role).
- CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification preferred.
- Strong knowledge of Financial Planning & Analysis, Financial Accounting, and P&L; management.
- Exposure to Wealth Management / BFSI domain preferred.
- Understanding of revenue recognition principles (e.g., IFRS 15) preferred but not mandatory.
- Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with ability to interpret complex data.
- Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and business partnering skills.
- Ability to summarize and present complex data in a clear, structured, and impactful manner.
- Experience with automation, analytics, or BI tools is an added advantage.
- Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Exposure to thought leadership, insight generation, or strategic finance initiatives preferred.

What you'll love about working here

- You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
- You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage or recent parent support via flexible work.
- At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

Job Title: Plant & Commercial Chartered Accountant - Completed (Preferred) and Pursuing Location: Corporate Office: Bhandup, Mumbai – 400078 Reporting To: Head of Finance Employment Type: Full-Time CTC: Competitive (Capped at ₹15,00,000/- per annum) Office Timings: ● Monday to Friday: 09:30 Hrs to 18:30 Hrs ● 1st, 3rd, and 5th (if any) Saturdays: 09:30 Hrs to 13:30 Hrs About the Organisations ● AGT Foods India Pvt. Ltd. is the Indian subsidiary of AGT Food and Ingredients Inc., an integrated agricultural processing and supply chain leader in pulses, grains, staple food commodities, and value-added food ingredients. Headquartered in Mumbai, AGT Foods India manages commodity procurement, import-export operations, trade financing, and high-volume distribution across regional and cross-border commercial trade corridors. ● Umami Agro Industry Pvt.

Ltd. is the new production arm, establishing an integrated food processing facility at Khopoli, Raigad. (Corporate Websites: www.agtfoods.com) Role Summary We are seeking an execution-oriented Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1–4 years of post-qualification experience in food processing, FMCG, or industrial discrete/process manufacturing. This hybrid commercial and plant accounting role oversees end-to-end operational bookkeeping, inventory costing, multi-entity ledger reconciliations, and statutory compliance (GST/TDS) across both AGT Foods India (corporate trading & commercial supply chains) and Umami Agro Industries (greenfield factory setup, pre-commissioning, and plant operations). The candidate will execute ground-level bookkeeping in Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365 and Advanced Excel.

Role Clarification: ● Current Operational Scope: ○ Hands-on transactional accounting and operational legwork across corporate and plant divisions. ○ Daily execution of 3-way matching (PO vs. GRN vs. Invoice), vendor scrutiny, voucher entries, and physical inventory reconciliations. ○ Setting up the Chart of Accounts, cost centres, project CAPEX ledgers, and trial balances for the new manufacturing facility. ○ Not an Advisory Role: Currently this is not a corporate statutory audit review, management consulting, investment banking, private equity valuation (DCF/NAV), or M&A desk profile.

Future possibilities of including these responsibilities. ● Future Strategic Evolution: ○ As the Khopoli plant transitions from setup to commercial scale, this role will evolve into commercial and financial leadership. ○ Responsibilities will expand into plant-level MIS, OPEX/CAPEX variance management, supply chain working capital strategy, corporate direct/indirect tax planning, and liaison with statutory audit partners and lenders.

Key Responsibilities 1. Core Bookkeeping, Multi-Entity AP/AR & Ledger Maintenance ● Establish, align, and maintain the Chart of Accounts, cost centres, and voucher postings across AGT Foods India and Umami Agro Industries. ● Perform daily 3-way matching: verify Purchase Orders (PO), weighbridge / Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), and vendor tax invoices prior to booking. ● Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), process scheduled vendor payment runs, and resolve supplier ledger disputes. ● Perform monthly bank reconciliations (BRS), inter-company trade/fund balance reconciliations, and general ledger scrutiny. 2.

Factory

Project CAPEX, Manufacturing Costing & Inventory Accounting ● Track raw grain intake, packaging materials, Work-in-Progress (WIP), finished stock, scrap, and process shrinkage/yield variances. ● Audit and record project CAPEX cash outflows, civil contractor milestone billings, machinery import documents, customs clearance costs, and fixed asset capitalization schedules. ● Conduct monthly and quarterly physical stock counts at the Isambe, Raigad factory site and regional storage warehouses; reconcile physical inventory with ERP balances.

• Direct & Indirect Statutory Compliance ● Prepare, reconcile, and file statutory returns: GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9) and TDS/TCS (24Q, 26Q)[cite: 6, 7]. ● Ensure compliance with Reverse Charge Mechanisms (RCM), E-Way bill generation, and input tax credit (ITC) matching (GSTR-2B vs. books of accounts). ● Prepare audit workpapers and coordinate with statutory and tax auditors for financial year-end finalization under Schedule III of the Companies Act[cite: 6, 7].
• ERP Operations & Advanced Financial Modelling ● Oversee day-to-day transaction entries, journal balancing, master data hygiene, and batch runs within Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365. ● Build dynamic, formula-driven financial models in Advanced Excel (XLOOKUP, Pivot tables, Index-Match, dynamic arrays) for plant cash-flow tracking, daily trade position reporting, and raw material procurement costing.

Candidate

Profile &

Qualifications ● Professional Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) registered with ICAI, 1–4 years of post-qualification experience ● Industry Background: Mandatory operational accounting background in Food Processing, Agro-Commodities, FMCG, or Process/Discrete Manufacturing. ● Greenfield / Setup Exposure: Prior experience participating in the accounting setup, Chart of Accounts formation, or pre-commissioning bookkeeping of a new plant, factory project, or subsidiary is strongly preferred. ● ERP Experience: Operational working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics AX (DAX) or Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations) is preferred; candidates with hands-on manufacturing experience in SAP (FICO) or similar enterprise ERPs will be considered. ● Technical Skills: High-level mastery of Advanced MS Excel for financial data cleanup and management reporting. ● Work Location & Mobility: Based primarily at the Bhandup, Mumbai corporate office, with flexibility for travel to the Umami Agro Industries factory site in Isambe, Raigad for physical inventory counts, asset audits, and operational accounting reviews.

Salary - upto 10Lpa

About bluCognition bluCognition is an AI-powered commercial credit intelligence company serving lenders and financial institutions. Our platform combines commercial credit data contributed by 150+ lenders with AI-driven analytics, banking data and fraud detection to help our clients make faster, better credit decisions. Our product suite includes bluSense, which converts bank statements into standardized, categorized transaction data with real-time financial insights, and FraudLens, which detects document tampering and first-party fraud.

Alongside our data products, we run a managed services business supporting underwriting, fraud review, and KYC/KYB and sanctions screening operations for our clients, with teams across North America, Asia and Europe.

About the Role

We are looking for an Analyst / Senior Analyst Credit Risk to support credit underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will involve financial analysis, credit assessment, underwriting execution and research, with responsibility for accurately evaluating financial and business information and supporting credit decisions. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of financial statements, good analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with structured and unstructured financial information.
Key Responsibilities

• Analyze financial statements, bank statements, tax documents, AR/AP aging and other business/financial documents to assess the financial position and creditworthiness of entities.

• Perform financial spreading, ratio analysis, cash-flow and working-capital analysis, support credit underwriting and decisioning, and monitor portfolio performance and key credit risk indicators.

• Conduct business and industry research, including verification of entity information and identification of relevant business or credit risks.

• Review supporting documentation, including commercial contracts, to identify inconsistencies, key terms and potential credit risks.

• Manage assigned underwriting cases and queues, ensuring accuracy, quality and adherence to client SLAs and processes.

• Maintain trackers, MIS and other process documentation, and support SOP, process improvement and automation initiatives.

What we are looking for

• 1 to 3 years of experience in credit risk, commercial credit underwriting, financial analysis or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flow, working capital and credit fundamentals, with the ability to assess a company's financial position.

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work with large volumes of financial and business information.

• Good understanding of MS Excel, including financial analysis and data handling.

• Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively with stakeholders.

• Ability to work in a structured, deadline-driven environment & adapt across multiple client processes / requirements.

Educational Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.

• MBA / M.Com / CA Inter / Semi-qualified CA or equivalent qualification is preferred.

• Relevant credit risk/underwriting experience will be considered in lieu of additional qualifications.
